identity_layers.meaning: A pinned passage that discusses a concept or case.
A proposed reusable operation definition, with a definition version.
An operation, its role-bearing arguments, and any retained qualifications; not evidence of occurrence.
A particular event requiring separate identity and occurrence evidence.

facets.meaning: All reachable topic roots through the legacy broader graph; possibly multiple.
Candidate discovery tags, not disjoint subtypes or rulings.
Bodily, spoken, written, gestural, or inward aspects; may overlap and remain unassigned.
Single, sequential, sustained, interactive, or composite descriptions; not an implemented action algebra.
Named roles and typed references; binding to the judgment subject is separate.
Source-reported intention, capacity, coercion, authority, time, and other facts; unknown is retained.
Ruling, validity, effect, and liability remain separate source/profile-bound claims.

methodological_loci.use: Distinguish doing and intentional restraint; do not identify restraint with mere nonoccurrence.
Distinguish sameness by kind from an individual act, and retain legally relevant relations and qualifications.
Words and deeds and worship and ordinary practices motivate independent facets, not a universal exhaustive taxonomy.

normalization_cases.note: Preserve the invalidity qualifier as a separate source-attributed claim; do not silently normalize to an unqualified sale.
Preserve coercion and its evidentiary status; consequences depend on the source profile.
Preserve the place and asserted rights status; do not derive prayer validity from the label.
Entering ihram and the continuing state are different senses; affect is not a generic state constructor.
The legacy act kind does not establish an intentional human act.
Do not map the animal-caused event to property.damage with a human acting_person.
The legacy item may have an operation sense; keep each sense and its evidence separate.
The legacy item does not by itself define the act of entrusting property.
An issue label can motivate an act proposal; responsibility and intention truth remain separate.
Preserve the nullification qualification. Neither voluntary control nor legal consequence follows from candidate kind=act.
The technical concept includes a rights qualification; bare taking-possession is not an equivalent replacement.
The item label must be interpreted by sense; an operation proposal establishes no duty or discharge.
